items.q: Paul Ash was across the street, and the... Portola Louvre!

ctx.x: were there a coupla years, and Art Hickman was playing right up the street from us, and Art Hickman was playing right up the street from us at the St. Francis Hotel, and all of their gang used to come down and listen at us all the time when...on their...during their intermission. Paul Ash was across the street, and the... Portola Louvre! That was the name of the big nightclub right at the... where the street...Powell and Market comes together, where the car turns around there.
Mmmmmhmmm, where the cable car turns around, uh huh.
